ns2:course.label: Equine Science
ns2:course.description: (ANSCI 306) Understand and apply current scientific research and principles of equine science to intensive horse production. An in-depth approach to equine reproductive physiology, nutrition, anatomy and exercise physiology will be followed using a combined lecture and laboratory format. Emphasis on current research and hands-on techniques. Prerequisite: ANSC 206, ANSC 331 and ANSC 362, or consent of instructor.
